title: The Lamb and the Knot
lines: Jen keeps a small lamb out by the shed.
The lamb likes to climb up on things.
Jen left a rope in a heap there.
The rope had a big knot in it.
One day the lamb went up on a rock.
It came down, but the knot caught its leg.
The lamb could not walk. It made a sound.
Jen went down on one knee to reach it.
She pulled the knot with her thumb. No luck.
So Jen got a bit of soap from Dad.
She rubbed the soap on the rope and knot.
Then the knot slid free! The lamb was out.
Jen wrapped the rope up and hung it high.
Now Jen knows where to keep her rope.

questions.ask: What was caught on the lamb's leg?
questions.listenFor: A knot in the rope. Have them find that line.

questions.ask: Jen pulled the knot first. What did she do when that did not work?
questions.listenFor: She got soap from Dad and rubbed it on the rope and knot.

questions.ask: What do you think Jen will do with the rope now? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Any answer is fine. The last two lines give a clue.
